Body.Content:
Enable project managers to view and track Committed Costs directly within Project Operations budgets, providing a complete picture of budget consumption beyond actual costs. This enhancement allows project managers to make more informed budgeting, forecasting, and project control decisions by incorporating costs that are contractually or operationally committed but not yet realized. This is for Project Operations core and Project Operations connected with ERP deployment types

GA date: August CY2027

Preview date: March CY2027
